overview_description.description:
FloatPays provides payroll integration, employee access, financial education, effective reporting, payment, and training services. Through access, budgeting, and training, the company is enabling its team to achieve financial well-being and moving them from debt to savings. 

The company was founded in 2019 and is based in Cape Town, Western Cape.

product.name: Floatpays Financial Wellness Platform
product.description: A unified employee financial wellness platform integrating earned wage access, savings, education, rewards, and communications.

product.name: Earned Wage Access
product.description: Allows employees to access a portion of their earned but unpaid wages before payday to manage cash flow and emergencies.

product.name: Earned Wage Access
product.description: A payroll-integrated service that lets employees access a portion of earned, unpaid wages before payday.

product.name: Automated Savings
product.description: Enables employees to automatically set aside a portion of their paycheck into a savings account to build financial security.

product.name: Employee Rewards
product.description: A program that incentivizes and recognizes employees to encourage positive financial behaviors and engagement.

product.name: Automated Savings
product.description: A paycheque-linked savings service that routes a portion of employee income into an interest-bearing savings account.
